# LibreOffice Impress GUI Interface

## System and Application Header

- **Operating System Environment**: Activities panel visible on the left side of the screen, indicating a Linux desktop environment.
- **Application Title Bar**: 
  - Application name: "LibreOffice Impress"
  - File name: "campaign_slides.pptx"
  - Current time: "Oct 23 16:43"
  - System icons: Bell icon (notifications), system tray icons (sound, network, etc.) on the right.
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, maximize, and close buttons on the top-right corner.

## Application Menu Bar

- **Menu Options**: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Slide, Slide Show, Tools, Window, Help.
- **Application Status**: The application is in edit mode for a presentation file.

## Toolbars

### Main Toolbar (Top)

- **File Operations**: New, Open, Save, Save As, Print.
- **Edit Tools**: Cut, Copy, Paste, Undo, Redo.
- **Drawing Tools**: Line, Rectangle, Ellipse, Arrow, Shapes (star, diamond, etc.), Text Box, Callout, etc.
- **Formatting Tools**: Font size, bold, italic, underline, text color, alignment, bullet points, etc.
- **Insertion Tools**: Image, Chart, Table, Video, Audio, Object, etc.
- **Slide Management**: Slide layout, Slide Master, Slide Show controls.
- **Additional Tools**: Find, Zoom, View options, etc.

### Secondary Toolbar (Below Main Toolbar)

- **Drawing Tools**: Line, Rectangle, Ellipse, Arrow, Shapes (star, diamond, etc.), Text Box, Callout, etc.
- **Formatting Tools**: Font size, bold, italic, underline, text color, alignment, bullet points, etc.
- **Insertion Tools**: Image, Chart, Table, Video, Audio, Object, etc.
- **Slide Management**: Slide layout, Slide Master, Slide Show controls.
- **Additional Tools**: Find, Zoom, View options, etc.

## Sidebar Panels

### Left Sidebar: Slides Panel

- **Slide Thumbnails**: 
  - 8 slides visible, numbered 1 to 8.
  - Slide 1: Title "Eradicating Heritable Disorders Through Prenatal Sterilization" with a white arrow on a yellow background.
  - Slides 2-8: All have a white arrow on a yellow background.
  - Slide 8 is currently selected (highlighted in brown).
- **Navigation**: Vertical scroll bar for navigating through slides.

### Right Sidebar: Properties Panel

#### Slide Properties

- **Format**: "On-scr... w (16:9)" (16:9 aspect ratio).
- **Orientation**: "Landscape".
- **Background**: "None" (with "Insert Image..." button below).
- **Master Slide**: "BLANK_4" (with dropdown menu).
- **Master Background**: Checkbox checked.
- **Master Objects**: Checkbox checked.
- **Master View**: Button available.

#### Layouts

- **Layout Selection**: 
  - 3x3 grid of layout options.
  - First layout (top-left) is selected (outlined in red).
  - Other layouts show different arrangements of title and content areas.

## Main Workspace

- **Current Slide**: Slide 8 of 8.
- **Slide Content**: 
  - Background: Solid yellow.
  - Graphic: Large white arrow pointing up and to the right.
  - No text or other elements visible on the slide.

## Status Bar

- **Slide Information**: "Slide 8 of 8".
- **Slide Name**: "BLANK_4".
- **Position**: "-0.39 / -1.40".
- **Scale**: "0.00 x 0.00".
- **Language**: "English (en)".
- **Zoom Level**: "123%".
- **Navigation**: Zoom slider and +/- buttons for zoom control.

## Notification Banner

- **LibreOffice Donation Banner**:
  - Two blue informational banners at the top of the workspace.
  - First banner: "Help us make LibreOffice even better!" with "Get involved" button.
  - Second banner: "Your donations support our worldwide community." with "Donate" button.
  - Both banners have close (X) buttons on the right.

## Desktop Environment

- **Left Dock**: 
  - Application icons: Google Chrome, Thunderbird, Visual Studio Code, VLC Media Player, LibreOffice Writer, LibreOffice Calc, LibreOffice Impress, GIMP, File Manager, Software Center, Help, Trash.
  - Grid icon at the bottom for application launcher.
- **Top Bar**: System status icons (network, sound, etc.) on the right.

## Additional UI Elements

- **Window Controls**: Minimize, maximize, close buttons on the top-right corner.
